aiMetadata.description: Sends a text message from the LINE bot directly to a single recipient identified by their LINE user ID. Use this to proactively message a user (not as a reply within a webhook session); the user ID is typically captured from an incoming message webhook payload. Not idempotent — each call delivers a new message.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

md.description:
- Create Line bot account from Developer Console
- Go to the "Messaging API" section.
- In the webhook settings, paste this URL: 
  `{{webhookUrl}}`
- Publish Activepieces flow first then click "Verify" button

aiMetadata.description: Fires when the LINE bot receives an inbound message event from a user via the Messaging API webhook. Each emitted item represents one active message event, carrying the sender details and message content needed to react or reply.
